correctness.rationale: For every input, harmonic interpolation equals its boundary contrast times a single potential. Exact triangle inequality gives G(x)>=(n-1)|x_b-x_a|, attained by common interior values in the endpoint interval. Summing the potential gives the exact identity; sorted adjacent gaps prove the sharp global envelope and all equality cases. Kirchhoff equations give the local nonexpansivity test. Exact unit-path arithmetic gives n(n+1)/(6(n-1)). An embedded exact-rational checker corroborates finite examples without replacing the proof.
